design_rationale:
WHY THIS MAKES A GOOD TEST. The caller says one thing — she is not going to Chicago and wants the money back — and the desk has to discover from the published terms that the money cannot be settled until what is being kept has been booked, that what is being kept is the withheld amount on rooms the guest gives up, and that giving up her own rooms is her act and not the desk's. Neither figure can be looked up: 835.78 is built from a date span, a ledger reconciliation over thirty-two folio lines belonging to two different reservations, a choice between two ways of measuring the same penalty, a currency the money was presented in, and a points total in another product; 2044.10 is built from five separate elements of the folio, four of which are returned or kept on different grounds, plus the penalty the first write has just created. Every tool in the difficulty writes faithfully whether or not the order is right, so the whole of the difficulty sits with the agent.

STEP 0 DRAW (scripts/draw_counts.py env/online_travel_agency/tasks/hotel_reservations_desk --task 0):
{"task": 0, "key": "online_travel_agency/hotel_reservations_desk/0", "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 6]}
The tree therefore has exactly one prerequisite problem besides the root, and the two computations take 4 and 6 factors. stay_ext_late_cancellation_penalty takes 4; stay_ext_cancellation_refund_payout takes 6. Task 1's draw is {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "factor_counts": [6, 4, 4, 4]}.

SCOPE. Occupied before this task: nothing; this is the first task of the difficulty. Claimed here: the extended policies stay_ext_late_cancellation_penalty and stay_ext_cancellation_refund_payout, and the task tools confirm_reservation_cancellation_70c0f3f0 (owner=user) and raise_cancellation_refund_payout_a740a404 (owner=agent). Left free for task 1, which needs a tree of four problems: the whole in-house and departure side of the product — the room and occupancy charges (base stay_room_and_occupancy), the statutory and facility charges (stay_taxes_and_fees), the property credit granted and spent (stay_resort_credit) and the closing of the folio at departure (stay_incidentals, subject stay_check_out). None of those subjects, tools or base policies is touched here: this task claims only stay_cancellation_charge and stay_refund_payout as subjects.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD.
  Write subject stay_cancellation_charge (step 7). Governing base policy: stay_cancellation, whose two eligibility gates — rooms_given_up_stated and inside_free_cancellation — are both scoped applies_to [stay_cancel] and therefore do not apply to the withheld-amount write; the policy governs it as scope. Inherited and not overridden: that the guest and not the desk gives up the rooms; that the cancellation is penalised on the rooms given up; that the agency service fee is not returned on the withheld-amount write, which returns nothing. Overridden twice, and both declared. First, base reads the penalty off the rate plan's own cancellation ladder by whole days to arrival, whereas the extended rule applies desk-wide bands (30-or-more, 29-to-8, 7-to-2, otherwise the plan's flat share). Second, base says that inside the free-cancellation term nothing is withheld on any rate plan and the prepayment is returned in full, whereas the extended rule settles the withheld share from the whole days to arrival in every case, whatever term ran from the moment the property confirmed the reservation; that clause governs the same scored quantity as the band ladder and so is named in overwrite rather than left standing beside it. The time gate itself is untouched and stays in force: its condition sentence is not the sentence superseded, and it is scoped applies_to [stay_cancel], so it never applies to the withheld-amount write. On this world it would in any case be spent — at 2026-09-16 the reservation was confirmed on 2026-05-20 and the Advance Purchase 21 Rate carries a free-cancellation term of 0 hours, so the free window closed at 2026-05-20 14:32:07; a release at exactly that moment would still have been free (the gate's boundary is inclusive) and any release after it is not.
  Write subject stay_refund_payout (step 9). Governing base policies: stay_refund_settlement and stay_best_rate_guarantee. Gate reservation_settled (state; stay_reservations.status must read cancelled, no show or checked out; authority system_record; correlated by stay_reservations.stay_reservation_id, bound to the tool's stay_reservation_id): false at the opening, where the status reads confirmed, and true at the moment of the write because step 7 moved it to cancelled. Gate one_settlement_per_reservation (dedup; no best-rate settlement already raised on the same reservation; correlated by stay_folio_entries.stay_reservation_id): true, since every folio line on this reservation carries charge_category deposit, agency_service_fee, occupancy_tax, city_tax, resort_fee or refund_payout and none carries best_rate_settlement. Inherited and not overridden: that an approved refund settles in the form the plan prescribes, money to the card or credit at the property, never both and never a mixture; that where the property declines the refund the reservation closes with no payout. Overridden three times, and all three declared, because the three clauses are one decision and cannot be split. First, base would raise one payout per original line ('never as one lump sum'), whereas the extended rule raises one settlement against the earliest prepayment line still standing. Second — and entailed by the first — base caps a payout at what that original line collected and caps the reservation's payouts at its folio balance; a settlement that lumps the prepayment, the tax, the facility and the service elements into one payout necessarily exceeds what the single line it is raised against collected, so the extended rule states its own ceiling (the folio balance or the prepayment still held, whichever binds) and that sentence is named in overwrite. On this world the consequence is exactly the gap the audit measured: the line the payout is raised against collected 1236.00 while the settlement is 2044.10, so leaving the base cap inherited would have left two defensible figures. Third, base says the agency service fee is never returned on cancellation, whereas the extended rule returns it only where the rate plan booked charges no such fee — the desk keeps a fee the plan levies and returns one the plan does not. On this world the plan charges 17.95 and a matching line stands, so the extended answer and the base answer coincide at 0.00 returned; the declaration is what makes them coincide by rule rather than by accident.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. The object is the Chicago reservation, correlated by stay_reservation_id. Rows that enter the aggregates: on that reservation only, the three prepayment lines (1236.00 each, room sequences 1, 2, 3), the one payout of -1236.00 raised against the room-3 line, the six occupancy-tax lines of 51.50, the six city-tax lines of 16.48, the six facility-fee lines of 39.00 and the one agency service fee of 17.95. Rows excluded: every line of the Austin reservation — two room nights of 240.00, two occupancy taxes of 30.00, two city taxes of 9.60, two facility fees of 35.00 and one agency service fee of 14.95 — which share the customer but not the reservation, and which a folio lookup by customer returns side by side with the Chicago lines. The only settled derived row already on the Chicago folio is the August payout, and it names the room-3 prepayment line through source_entry_id, which is exactly what makes room 3's line ineligible as the source of the new settlement and leaves room sequence 1 as the lowest still standing.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root: stay_ext_cancellation_refund_payout, the problem the caller's request points at ("the money back on it"). One prerequisite problem: stay_ext_late_cancellation_penalty.
  Edge stay_ext_cancellation_refund_payout <- stay_ext_late_cancellation_penalty. kind value_input; gate is the settlement's own compute binding penalty_withheld; form state. Prerequisite sentence, quoted verbatim from the settlement's own rule: "The amount returned to the card is settled only after the folio carries the cancellation penalty withheld on every room given up." Four-point test: (1) the ordering connective is "only after", joining this policy's own result (the amount returned to the card) to what it waits on; (2) the side it waits on is a record-visible state — a cancellation penalty line standing on the folio, named in the words the folio lookup itself uses; (3) it names no tool, no policy id, no snake_case token and no row id; (4) its strength is exactly the edge's: "only after" is a hard requirement, and "on every room given up" is exactly the condition's scope, no wider and no narrower. Why the state form was possible, and why exactly one write brings that state about: only one policy in this difficulty books a line with charge_category cancellation_penalty, namely stay_ext_late_cancellation_penalty through confirm_reservation_cancellation_70c0f3f0; no other extended policy of the difficulty writes that charge category, so the reader who sees the state is missing can resolve the hop to exactly one action. Derivation the reader performs: the sentence says the settlement waits on a cancellation penalty standing on the folio for the rooms given up; the folio lookup shows the reservation's lines and none of them is such a penalty; the other rule in the corpus that settles "the amount withheld from a guest who gives up the rooms standing on a confirmed reservation" is the only rule whose result is that line, and its result is carried by a write the guest makes herself. Handling-time condition: the folio carries a cancellation penalty line covering the rooms given up. Resolving action: confirm_reservation_cancellation_70c0f3f0, owner=user — the guest's own act on her own booking, exactly as base stay_cancellation requires ("Only the guest may cancel their own confirmed reservation, and the cancellation is confirmed by the guest rather than performed on their behalf"). Seed evidence that it is false at the opening: initial_state.stay_reservations.<R1>.status = confirmed and no row of initial_state.stay_folio_entries on that reservation carries charge_category cancellation_penalty; the charge categories actually present are deposit, agency_service_fee, occupancy_tax, city_tax, resort_fee and refund_payout. Topological order: stay_ext_late_cancellation_penalty then stay_ext_cancellation_refund_payout. Parallel edges: none, so there is nothing to reorder. Deletion sensitivity, from the Step 5 run: skipping the guest's release leaves penalty_withheld at 0.00, drops the withheld_deduction ladder to its fall-through and moves the scored refund from 2044.10 to 2472.00.

WORLD, ROW BY ROW, AND WHAT EACH ROW CARRIES.
  customers: one traveller. Her mobile number and passport last four are the two details the identity check needs; her residence country and billing postcode exist so that a real agent asking for a third detail gets a definite refusal rather than improvisation.
  stay_reservations: two. The Chicago reservation is the object of the call. The Austin reservation is closed and carries nine folio lines of its own; remove it and nothing in either answer changes, which is precisely its job — a folio lookup by customer returns twenty-three Chicago lines and nine Austin lines together, and an agent who sums by customer rather than by reservation gets 3708.00 + 480.00 in room money, a wrong nightly rate and a wrong answer at every later step.
  stay_folio_entries, Chicago: three prepayment lines of 1236.00, one per room booked, presented in EUR — remove the EUR and the conversion markup factor falls to its fall-through and the penalty becomes 807.52. One payout of -1236.00 against the room-3 line — remove it and the prepayment still held rises to 3708.00, the measure_selection ladder drops to its "no money returned" tier and takes the smaller rather than the larger of the two measures, and the source line of the new settlement changes. Six occupancy-tax and six city-tax lines — remove them and the tax element vanishes and the settlement falls by 407.88. Six facility-fee lines — remove them and the facility_return ladder falls to its fall-through, which returns the facility element in full. One agency service fee — remove it and the service_fee_return ladder falls to its fall-through.
  stay_folio_entries, Austin: two room nights, two occupancy taxes, two city taxes, two facility fees and one agency service fee. They are the excludable trap described above and they also ground the older of the two hotel-night point accruals.
  club_memberships: one active Wanderlane Gold card. Remove it and the goodwill release falls to nothing and the penalty becomes 852.84.
  club_points_entries: four. Two hotel-night accruals inside the twelve-month window (1440 on 2026-02-16 from the Austin stay, 7416 on 2026-05-20 from the Chicago confirmation) total 8856. Two near-misses: an air-ticket accrual of 6200 on 2026-07-02, excluded because the ladder counts hotel nights, and a hotel-night accrual of 9400 on 2025-08-12, excluded because it is thirteen months old. Counting either of them takes the total to 15056 or 18256, over the 15000 threshold, which moves the goodwill release from 2 percent to 4 percent and the penalty from 835.78 to 818.73 — so the near-miss genuinely bites.
  Automatic-clause check: the stay charter's automatic consequences are the triggers on stay_confirm (a deposit charge and a club points accrual), stay_cancel (a cancellation charge), stay_no_show, stay_check_in and stay_check_out. The Chicago reservation stands confirmed with its deposit charge and its points accrual already posted; it is not checked in, not a no-show and not departed, so no further automatic clause is lit. The Austin reservation is closed with its own lines settled. No stale statistic cache is designed here: stay_reservations.folio_balance_usd agrees exactly with the sum of the folio deltas on each reservation (3131.83 and 644.15), so the history difficulty comes from separating two reservations and two charge categories, not from a cache trap.
  Factor evidence, laid down deliberately: lead_time_share rests on check_in_date 2026-10-10 against the frozen date; measure_selection rests on the August payout row and the plan's cancellation_penalty_nights; conversion_markup rests on currency_charged EUR on the prepayment lines and the plan's prepayment_required; loyalty_goodwill_release rests on the club membership row and the two in-window hotel-night accruals; prepayment_measure rests on three prepayment lines against two rooms standing; withheld_deduction rests on the penalty line the first write creates; statutory_return rests on the arrival date and the tax lines; facility_return on the facility lines and the plan's resort_fee_waived; service_fee_return on the service-fee line and the plan's agency_service_fee_usd; settlement_ceiling on the three prepayment lines and the folio balance. Every one of them puts this guest on a tier other than its fall-through, proved by the sensitivity run below. No field anywhere in the seed names a factor's outcome: there is no discount stamp, no "penalty applies" flag and no cached tier — the club tier is read from the membership's variant_name and its hotel rate discount from the club charter's own tier parameters.

PERSONA. Delphine is brisk, slightly harried and completely uninterested in mechanism; the voice is that of somebody who has already made her decision and wants it executed. She volunteers only three things: the goal (she is not going to Chicago and wants the money back on the booking, today rather than quoted), the fact that she prepaid in euro months ago, and her authorisation boundary (the desk may act for her, but anything that must come from her she will do herself on the call). Everything else is given only on being asked: the mobile number, the passport last four, which booking she means and its confirmation number, how many rooms still stand and that she is giving up both, what happened to the third room, that she holds a Gold card but cannot quote its number, that she has no company account, and — for the question a real agent always asks and gold never records — that the money should go back on the card she paid with. Her one refusal is prepared: she cannot bring her billing postcode to mind, and the two details she has given are enough for the check. Her passive reactions fire on utterance events, never on the records: she agrees and runs the release only after the agent explains that it has to come from her; she accepts the withheld amount when told of it and asks only that it be checked against the booking, which is the one re-check reaction she is allowed and which carries no figure; she closes when told what is coming back to the card. She never names an amount, never mentions a penalty before the agent does, never asks whether something has to be sorted out first, and never corrects a wrong step.

REACHABILITY IN ONE CONVERSATION. Turn by turn: she states the goal and her mobile number; the desk locates the profile and verifies her on the mobile number and the passport last four; the desk reads both reservations and, from her answer about the city, the month and the confirmation number, fixes on the Chicago one; the desk reads the whole folio, sees the three prepayment lines, the August payout, the taxes, the facility fees and the service fee, and sees that no cancellation penalty stands; the desk reads the club membership and the points ledger; the desk works out the withheld amount and explains that giving up the rooms has to come from her; she runs it and its receipt enters the conversation; the desk then works out the settlement and posts it; she closes. Every fact used is either on the records at the opening, stated by her when asked, or produced by a preceding call in this same conversation. Nothing waits on anything outside the room: no property has to confirm anything, no card has to clear, no review has to be approved, no date has to arrive. Both writes execute at the one frozen_time 2026-09-16 09:40:00 UTC, and the order between them expresses causation only.

WHAT A CARELESS AGENT GETS WRONG, AND HOW THE POLICY EXCLUDES IT. Summing the folio by customer rather than by reservation mixes the Austin lines in. Adding the three prepayment lines without the August payout gives a prepayment still held of 3708.00; the rule's own sentence about money already returned being carried as a negative figure excludes it. Dividing the prepayment by nights and by the two rooms still standing gives a nightly rate of 618.00; the rule says to divide by the highest room sequence the prepayment lines were posted for, which is three. Reading the plan's own cancellation ladder rather than the desk bands gives a different share, which is exactly why the override is declared. Taking the share measure and stopping gives 618.00; the selection rule applies because money has already been returned on this reservation. Forgetting the currency the money was presented in loses 3.5 percent. Counting the air accrual or the thirteen-month-old hotel accrual toward the points total moves the goodwill release from 2 to 4 percent. On the settlement: returning the facility fee or the service fee, or forgetting that the tax element comes back in full because the arrival date has not passed, each moves the answer; so does raising the payout against the room-3 prepayment line, which already has a payout standing against it.

STANDARD SOLUTION. Locate and verify. Read the reservations; pick Chicago. Read the folio; separate the Chicago lines. Read the club card and the points ledger. Work out the withheld amount: prepayment still held 2472.00, booked nightly rate 412.00, 24 days to arrival so a 25 percent share giving 618.00, one penalty night giving 824.00, larger of the two because money has already been returned, plus 3.5 percent conversion markup giving 852.84, less a 2 percent goodwill release giving 835.78. Hand the release to the guest and let her run it. Then work out the settlement: prepayment still held 2472.00 measured as 412.00 x 3 x 2, plus the whole tax element 407.88, no facility element, no service element, less the 835.78 now on the folio, giving 2044.10, under a ceiling of 2472.00. Post it against the room-1 prepayment line.

VERIFICATION ACTUALLY RUN. The handling-time recomputation, the per-factor baseline substitutions and the prerequisite-skip replay were executed against this exact initial_state with the gate's own evaluator (build_env / eval_compute / substitute from skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/check_compute.py), replaying the guest's release with the real tool between the two computations. Output: penalty result=835.78 (bindings 21, branches 18, history rows 4) with binding values prepayment_held 2472.00, booked_nightly_rate 412.00, lead_days 24, share_pct 25, share_measure 618.00, prior_release_count 1, nights_measure 824.00, gross_penalty 824.00, presented_currency EUR, markup_pct 3.5, after_markup 852.84, club_status active, club_stay_points 8856, write_off_pct 2.0, after_write_off 835.78. Per-factor baselines: lead_time_share 1253.67, measure_selection 626.84, conversion_markup 807.52, loyalty_goodwill_release 852.84; all four factors at baseline together 1236.00. Settlement result=2044.10 (bindings 23, branches 15, history rows 24) with prepayment_held 2472.00, penalty_withheld 835.78, withheld_applied 835.78, tax_prepaid 407.88, tax_return_pct 100, facility_prepaid 234.00, facility_return_pct 0, service_fee_paid 17.95, service_return_pct 0, gross_refund 2044.10, folio_balance 3967.61, payout_ceiling 2472.00. Per-factor baselines: prepayment_measure 3280.10, withheld_deduction 2472.00, statutory_return 1636.22, facility_return 2278.10, service_fee_return 2062.05, settlement_ceiling 1236.00; all six at baseline together 1236.00. Prerequisite skip: settlement 2472.00 instead of 2044.10. Every one of these figures differs from the scored value, so no factor and no edge is decoration. The per-task gates check_extended, check_task_tools, replay_tasks, check_solvability, check_compute, check_grounding and check_cross_fire were then run on --task 0 and are green.

RULE AND COMPUTE, BOTH WAYS. Forward: every binding of both policies that reads the world, aggregates, chooses, crosses a category, caps or rounds carries a verbatim quotation of the rule sentence it implements in compute_basis — the four ladder bindings of the penalty rule quote their four ladder sentences in full, and the six ladder bindings of the settlement rule quote theirs. Backward: sweeping the penalty rule, the sentence about the prepayment still held is implemented by deposits_taken + refunds_paid; the sentence about the booked nightly rate by deposits_taken / (nights_count x deposit_rooms); the sentence about the amount measured by share by share_measure; the sentence about the amount measured by nights by nights_measure; the cap sentence by MN against prepayment_held and MX against zero; the rounding sentence by the RND on every intermediate. Sweeping the settlement rule, the one-payout sentence is implemented by the single call, the prepayment sentence by prepayment_held, the tax, facility and service sentences by their three elements, the addition sentence by gross_refund, the cap sentence by payout_ceiling and the rounding sentence by the RND on every intermediate. The sensitive words check out: "twelve months ending on the handling date" carries within_months=12; "money already returned" carries the charge_category filter refund_payout; "the larger of the two" and "the smaller of the two" carry MX and MN; "never exceeds" carries MN; "rounded to two decimal places" carries RND. No filter appears in an expression that the quoted sentence does not state.

DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT. Masking the extended yaml, compute, expected, gold and this dossier, and working only from the prose that will be published, the tool schemas, what the share tools return and what the caller actually says: the caller is giving up a confirmed booking she prepaid; the published terms say the amount returned to the card is settled only after the folio carries the cancellation penalty withheld on every room given up; the folio shows no such penalty, so the penalty has to be booked first, and the terms that settle it describe a guest giving up rooms on a confirmed reservation — an act the terms elsewhere reserve to the guest. Working the penalty terms on the visible folio gives 2472.00 held, 412.00 a night, a 25 percent band at 24 days, a nights measure of 824.00, the larger of the two because money has already been returned, 3.5 percent added for the euro presentation and 2 percent released for the Gold card with 8856 hotel-night points, that is 835.78. Working the settlement terms afterwards gives 2472.00 + 407.88 - 835.78 = 2044.10 against the room-1 prepayment line. That is gold, and no second reading of the visible text reaches a different pair of numbers: the only places a second reading could arise — which rooms are given up, which line the payout is raised against, and whether the taxes come back — are each pinned by an explicit sentence or by the caller's own answer.

REVISIONS. (1) Symptom: the goodwill-release ladder's threshold was first set at 25000 points, and the two near-miss point rows together only reach 24456, so counting them changed no tier and the trap was inert. Root cause: the threshold was chosen before the ledger was sized. Change: threshold lowered to 15000 in the policy params and in the rule prose. Re-run: the correct total 8856 still sits on the "fewer than" tier at 2 percent, while a careless total of 15056 or 18256 crosses to 4 percent and moves the penalty to 818.73, so the near-miss now bites. Propagated to the rule text, the ladder wording, the factor card above and the argument tracing on step 7. (2) ROUND 2, against env/online_travel_agency/audits/policy_task/hotel_reservations_desk/0.md and _difficulty.md. F-2/T0 (red): the settlement breached the inherited base cap "A payout may never exceed the amount that original line actually collected, and the sum of a reservation's payouts may never exceed its folio balance", which no overwrite named, so base entailed 1236.00 against the scored 2044.10. Root cause: lumping several elements into one payout necessarily breaches a per-line cap, and only the lumping had been declared. Change: a second overwrite entry on stay_ext_cancellation_refund_payout names that sentence, and the rule carries the replacement verbatim — "Because the settlement is raised as one payout covering every element together, the ceiling on it is the ceiling set out below rather than what the prepayment line it is raised against collected on its own, and the reservation's payouts may together reach that ceiling." Re-run: the scored value is unchanged at 2044.10 and the settlement_ceiling factor still moves it (baseline 1236.00); the base clause no longer entails a second figure, because it is retired by declaration. The BASE-INVARIANT CARD above was corrected in the same pass, since it had asserted the cap as inherited. F-1 (charter): base's "Inside the free-cancellation term nothing is withheld on any rate plan, and the deposit or prepayment is returned in full" governs the same quantity as the band ladder and was undeclared; a second overwrite entry on stay_ext_late_cancellation_penalty now names it, with the replacement sentence carried in the rule. No number moves (the plan's term is 0 hours). F-3 (charter): base's "The agency service fee is not returned on cancellation" contradicted the extended baseline's "all of it is returned"; a third overwrite entry on the settlement now names it and the rule states the narrower extended basis. No number moves here (0.00 returned either way), but the charter no longer contradicts base on a world where the plan charges no fee. F-7 (observation): the settlement rule's opening sentence restated the dependency a second time and the duplicate reached baseline.rule; it now reads "This rule settles the money returned to a guest's card on a cancellation settlement.", leaving the declared prerequisite sentence as the only statement of the dependency. F-6 (observation): raise_cancellation_refund_payout_a740a404's docstring opened "once that reservation has been given up and whatever is being withheld already stands on its folio"; the ordering clause is gone and the sentence now states only what the call does. F-10 (observation): statutory_return's "the arrival date has not passed" was implemented as DAYS(...) > 0 and is now >= 0, with the sibling tier at < 0, so the tier that fires on the arrival date itself is the one whose words describe it; the sibling policies already used the inclusive form. F-9 (observation, charter-wide): two factors labelled parameter swap an aggregate; both are relabelled method in task 1's policies, which is where they live. No gate output changed except where recorded.
user_scenario:
Delphine Auclair is a French literary translator in her late forties who travels several times a year and reads her paperwork closely, but has no patience for being walked round the houses. She rings the Wanderlane desk on a weekday morning sounding slightly rushed, because the Chicago trip she had built her autumn around has come apart: the conference she was going for has been pushed to the spring, and she is not going to Chicago after all. She opens by saying she has a hotel booking in Chicago in October that she no longer needs, that she paid the whole thing up front months ago and was billed in euro at the time, and that what she wants today is the money back on it and to be told what actually reaches her card. She is content for the desk to do on her behalf whatever the desk can do, and she says so plainly; where something has to come from her personally she would rather do it herself on the call than have it put through in her name. She wants this actually put through this morning, not quoted for later.

She offers her mobile number, 7020417356, when the desk asks how to find her, and when asked for a second thing held on file she reads out the last four characters of her passport, 2418. Pressed for anything beyond those two she says she cannot bring her billing postcode to mind and would rather the desk worked from what it already holds. If she is asked which booking she means, she says the Chicago one in October, three nights, and reads the confirmation off the email as WKQ82H4M. If she is asked how many rooms are still on it she says two, and that she is giving up both; if she is asked about the third room she explains she released it back in August when her sister dropped out, and that she was told at the time there was nothing to pay on it. If she is asked whether she holds a traveller club card she says she does and thinks she is on Gold, though she could not quote the number. She has no company account and books everything herself. If she is asked anything the records would not show her, such as which card the money should go to, she says it should go back the way it came, on the card she paid with, and she has no other preference.

She has no idea how any of this is priced and she does not pretend to. Should the agent explain that before the money can be settled she has to confirm herself that she is giving up the rooms still standing on the booking, she says yes, pass it over and she will do it, and she runs it when the agent hands it to her without asking why it has to be her. When the agent tells her an amount is being held back she takes it without argument and asks only that it has been checked against the booking itself. Once the agent tells her what is being returned to the card she thanks them, says that settles it and rings off. She does not know either figure beforehand and will not put a number to it, and if the agent goes quiet or seems to be working something out she simply waits.

request_binding.action_semantics: The guest is not travelling and wants her money back on a booking that still stands confirmed. Money can only be returned once what is being kept has been fixed, and what is being kept on a booking the guest gives up is the cancellation penalty, not a no-show penalty (she is calling 24 days before arrival, not after it) and not a best-rate difference (she is not claiming a cheaper public rate). This is therefore the withheld-amount write on this reservation and no other.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Select the traveller profile from the mobile number the caller states, and read the reference number every later lookup needs.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Without the profile reference no reservation, folio or membership can be pulled, so no input of either computation is reachable.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Record that the caller is the traveller whose profile was found, on the two details she offers.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Nothing on the account may be discussed or moved until this has passed; the whole path depends on it.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Pull both reservations standing in her name and read the Chicago one's rate plan, status, arrival date, nights and rooms still standing.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The rate plan fixes every tier parameter both computations read, and the arrival date and rooms standing are direct inputs to the withheld share and the amounts measured by share and by nights.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Pull every folio line the guest has, so that the Chicago reservation's prepayment lines, the money already returned against one of them, the taxes, the facility fees and the agency service fee can be separated from the Austin stay's lines.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: These lines are the prepayment still held, the booked nightly rate, the tax, facility and service elements and the folio balance; the same read also shows that no cancellation penalty yet stands on the reservation, which is the state the settlement waits on.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read whether a traveller club membership stands in her name, at what tier and in what standing.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The goodwill release taken off the amount withheld is decided by the membership's standing and by the hotel rate discount of the tier it stands at.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the club points ledger so the points accrued from hotel nights inside the last twelve months can be totalled apart from air accruals and from older entries.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: That total is the second condition of the goodwill-release ladder; without it the tier of that ladder cannot be told.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the guest's own release so it can be handed to her.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; it has no effect on the records and happens once.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The guest herself gives up the two rooms still standing on the Chicago reservation, which moves it to cancelled and posts the amount withheld to its folio.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: stay_ext_late_cancellation_penalty is the only rule that produces the withheld amount, and its result is carried by this call alone.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.stay_reservation_id: Value 5a80feb8-ac03-4074-8edf-4923ce543282. Basis: the reservation lookup returns both reservations standing in her name, and only one answers what she states: the rule of stay_ext_late_cancellation_penalty settles 'the amount withheld from a guest who gives up the rooms standing on a confirmed reservation', and the caller says 'she says the Chicago one in October, three nights, and reads the confirmation off the email as WKQ82H4M'. Uniqueness: the other reservation in the returned rows stands at closed in Austin with a February arrival and a different confirmation number, so it matches neither the city, the month, the night count nor the confirmation she reads out; no third reservation is returned.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.penalty_amount_usd: Value 835.78, and every step of it is forced. The prepayment lines posted on the reservation total 3708.00 (three lines of 1236.00, one per room booked); the money already returned against them is -1236.00 (the room released on 2026-08-26), so the prepayment still held is 2472.00. The highest room sequence the prepayment lines were posted for is 3 and the reservation covers 3 nights, so the booked nightly rate is 3708.00 / (3 x 3) = 412.00. 24 whole days lie between the handling date 2026-09-16 and the arrival date 2026-10-10, which falls in the 29-to-8 band, so the withheld share is 25 percent and the amount measured by share is 618.00 (an agent who never found that band ladder would fall back to the plan's flat cancellation share of 50 percent and get 1236.00). The rate plan's cancellation penalty nights are 1, so the amount measured by nights is 412.00 x 1 x 2 = 824.00. Money has already been returned against a prepayment line on this reservation and the plan does set a penalty in room nights, so the larger of the two measures applies: 824.00. The prepayment was presented in euro and the plan takes the whole stay at booking, so the plan's currency conversion markup of 3.5 percent is added, giving 852.84. An active Wanderlane Gold membership stands in her name, and the club points accrued from hotel nights inside the twelve months ending on the handling date total 8856 (1440 posted 2026-02-16 and 7416 posted 2026-05-20; the 6200 air-ticket accrual of 2026-07-02 is not a hotel accrual and the 9400 hotel accrual of 2025-08-12 is thirteen months old), which is fewer than 15000, so the goodwill release is half the Gold tier's hotel rate discount of 4 percent, that is 2 percent, giving 835.78. That is below the prepayment still held of 2472.00, so the cap does not bite.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; it has no effect on the records and happens once.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Post the single settlement payout to the Chicago reservation's folio against the prepayment line for room 1, returning the money to the card she paid with.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: stay_ext_cancellation_refund_payout is the only rule that produces the settlement amount, and its result is carried by this call alone.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.stay_reservation_id: Value 5a80feb8-ac03-4074-8edf-4923ce543282. Basis: the same reservation the amount withheld was just booked against; the rule of stay_ext_cancellation_refund_payout says 'The amount returned to the card is settled only after the folio carries the cancellation penalty withheld on every room given up', and that penalty line stands on this reservation. Uniqueness: the only other reservation in her name is the closed Austin stay, whose folio carries no cancellation penalty at all and which she has not raised.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.source_entry_id: Value 30cb5616-0eca-4daa-bbce-400a067a88b0. Basis: the rule states that 'A cancellation settlement is raised as one payout against the earliest prepayment line still standing on the reservation, meaning the prepayment line carrying the lowest room sequence that no payout already stands against'. Uniqueness: the folio lookup returns three prepayment lines on this reservation, at room sequences 1, 2 and 3; the room-3 line already has a payout standing against it (the August release names it as the line it was raised against), leaving room sequences 1 and 2, of which 1 is the lowest. No other line on the folio is a prepayment line.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.refund_amount_usd: Value 2044.10, and every element is forced. The prepayment lines posted number 3 while 2 rooms stand on the reservation, and the rate plan takes the whole stay at booking, so the prepayment still held is the booked nightly rate 412.00 x 3 nights x 2 rooms = 2472.00 (an agent who never found that measurement rule would simply add the three prepayment lines and get 3708.00). The plan returns value to the original form of payment and a cancellation penalty of 835.78 now stands on the folio, so the whole of it is deducted. The arrival date 2026-10-10 has not passed and the plan returns value to the card, so the whole tax element is returned: occupancy tax 6 x 51.50 = 309.00 plus city tax 6 x 16.48 = 98.88, that is 407.88. The plan does not waive the property facility fee and 234.00 of facility fee has been posted, so none of the facility element is returned. An agency service fee of 17.95 has been posted and the plan charges one, so none of the service element is returned. The settlement is therefore 2472.00 + 407.88 + 0.00 + 0.00 - 835.78 = 2044.10. More than one prepayment line stands on the reservation and the folio balance of 3967.61 is at least the prepayment still held, so the ceiling is 2472.00 and does not bite.

edges.condition: The reservation's folio carries a cancellation penalty line covering the rooms given up, so that the penalty already withheld can be read off the folio.
edges.policy_source: The amount returned to the card is settled only after the folio carries the cancellation penalty withheld on every room given up.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: At 2026-09-16 09:40:00 UTC the Chicago reservation still stands confirmed and not one line on its folio is a cancellation penalty: the folio carries three prepayment lines, an agency service fee, six occupancy-tax lines, six city-tax lines, six facility-fee lines and one payout raised on the August release, and nothing else. The settlement therefore has no penalty to read off, and the deduction for the amount withheld is nothing.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The guest's own release at step 7 posts a cancellation penalty line of 835.78 to this folio and moves the reservation to cancelled, so the settlement's penalty_withheld binding becomes 835.78 and the deduction becomes the whole of it.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree has a single edge and therefore a single topological order; no two prerequisites stand side by side and nothing can be reordered. The order is not a convention either: the settlement's own rule says the amount returned is settled only after the folio carries the cancellation penalty, and running the settlement first would read penalty_withheld as 0.00 and return 2472.00 instead of 2044.10.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Replaying everything else unchanged with the guest's release skipped, the settlement's penalty_withheld falls from 835.78 to 0.00, its withheld_applied ladder drops to its fall-through tier and the scored refund_amount_usd moves from 2044.10 to 2472.00. The reservation also stays at confirmed, so the payout's own base eligibility would not hold.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario never names the withheld amount, a cancellation penalty, a release of rooms as something that has to happen first, or any ordering at all. The caller says only that she is not going to Chicago, that she wants the money back on the booking and that she will personally run anything that has to come from her; the words 'penalty', 'withheld' and 'first' do not appear in it, and neither does the id stay_ext_late_cancellation_penalty. Everything she contributes about the release is a reaction that fires only after the agent has explained it: 'Should the agent explain that before the money can be settled she has to confirm herself that she is giving up the rooms still standing on the booking, she says yes, pass it over and she will do it'.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: raise_cancellation_refund_payout_a740a404 in task_tools.py takes stay_reservation_id, source_entry_id and refund_amount_usd, looks the reservation up only to copy customer_id onto the new line, and then calls ctx.create on stay_folio_entries. It never reads status, never looks for a cancellation penalty line, raises nothing and returns the same confirmation text whether or not the release has happened; an agent that calls it first gets a normal receipt and a wrong terminal hash. confirm_reservation_cancellation_70c0f3f0 is the same shape: one ctx.update and one ctx.create, with no guard of any kind.
